lines.trans: Kostya, I do not know what happened.
But I want to tell you one thing.
Many years ago I quarreled with my father.
But recently, as you know, we made up.
I deeply regret that I waited so long.
But remember that time flies by unnoticed.
I never got the money today.

words.gloss: to wait for, to live to see

lines.trans: Forgive us, please, we will pay everything back.
Stop crying and shouting loudly in here.
People live with one kidney too.
And right now you have two of them.
Next time I will not be joking.

examples.text: Пусть они сначала ещё немного выпьют.
examples.trans: Let them drink a little more first.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian cardinal or ordinal numeral meaning 'two', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: У меня сейчас есть два варианта.
examples.trans: I have two options right now.

examples.text: А я сейчас удваиваю нашу ставку.
examples.trans: And I am doubling our bet right now.

examples.text: Через две недели.
examples.trans: In two weeks.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'in, into', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Теперь у нас точно всё кончено.
examples.trans: Now everything is definitely over between us.

examples.text: Погоди, друг, не спеши с выводами.
examples.trans: Wait, my friend, do not rush to conclusions.

examples.text: О чём ты вообще сейчас говоришь?
examples.trans: What are you even talking about right now?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ледующий'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('next').

examples.text: В следующий раз я шутить не буду.
examples.trans: Next time I will not be joking.

examples.text: В следующий раз не опаздывай.
examples.trans: Don't be late next time.

examples.text: А ты в следующий раз на мои деньги не рассчитывай. И всё будет хорошо.
examples.trans: Well, next time don't count on my money. And everything will be fine.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'time, occasion' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Мне осталось только со Светой разобраться.
examples.trans: I only have left to sort things out with Sveta.

examples.text: Ладно, давай быстро заканчиваем наш разговор.
examples.trans: Alright, let us quickly finish our conversation.

examples.text: А в ответ получаешь сплошное разочарование.
examples.trans: And in return you get complete disappointment.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to joke', paired with 'пошутить'.

examples.text: В следующий раз я шутить не буду.
examples.trans: Next time I will not be joking.

examples.text: Ты шутишь?
examples.trans: Are you joking?

examples.text: Я не шучу.
examples.trans: I'm not joking.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'will be'.

examples.text: Слушай, может быть, я просто уеду?
examples.trans: Listen, maybe I will just go away?

examples.text: На её месте должен был быть ты.
examples.trans: You were supposed to be in her place.

examples.text: У меня есть машинка.
examples.trans: I have a toy car.
